title: Food+
description: This is a mod that adds food to your game! (Get it? Add and +? Nmv)
body: This mod adds Flour, Dough, Baguettes, Raw Bageles, Cooked Bageles, Raw Bacon _(Dropped by pigs)_, Cooked Bacon, Cooked Eggs, Egg Sandwiches, Cherries _(somtimes dropped from Cherry leaves)_, Cherry Pies and Apple Pies. **Evrything is in a Creative Invintory Tab Called Weird Food.** My brother thinks the bacon looks like bent pink glow sticks, so download this mod to prove him wrong. or, you could download it becuase it adds a _nice_ feel to the game with foods that are realistically accurate. _(The recipies are realisically accurate.)_ ![BAGUETTE!!!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65ad0056141646d65523ce3055e30c63fcfbd6e2.png) Download for Baguette
